nl: A long job is running and appends its progress to logs/job.log. Report its latest progress value. Do not stop the job (job 3).

entries.content_utf8:
import pathlib
import sys
import time

pathlib.Path("logs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
with open("logs/job.log", "a") as log:
    for value in range(10, int(sys.argv[2]) + 1, 10):
        log.write(f"progress {value}%\n")
        log.flush()
while True:
    time.sleep(1)

setup.description: tools/progress.py runs in the background and has written its progress to logs/job.log.
setup.bash:
setsid python3 tools/progress.py bench-progress-3 30 > /dev/null 2>&1 < /dev/null &
for i in $(seq 100); do [ -s logs/job.log ] && break; sleep 0.1; done
